knownConflicts.summary: product-card-01 proved a generic chassis rather than authored website design.
The first Product Card 02 pass attempted function before visual architecture was locked.
Phase A round 01 used ten isolated art-card treatments, weak concepts and an unclear grouping presentation.
Phase A round 02 was rejected as generic, over-decorated and too narrow.
Phase A round 03 was rejected as vibe-coded card design; the rebuild brief redirected to the play-orb and atlas expression lineage.
Phase A round 04 was rejected for forcing the disc, providing too little layout variation and insufficient realistic website context.
Phase A round 05 improved range but remained materially below a professional world-leading software product system; only six specimens received keep verdicts.
Phase A round 06 abandoned approved rounded geometry, hid the established expression vocabulary behind invented worlds and made animation manual; S02 was its sole keep.

Round 07 found the right language but required controlled refinement: PC01, PC02 and SC04 were kept; PC03–PC05 and ED04 were killed; internal IDs, decorative numbers and forced objects were removed for Round 08.
Round 08 converged the system with 20 keeps, 16 kills, 13 revisions and one unreviewed specimen. Round 09 may only preserve survivors, implement explicit revisions and remove killed paths.

Round 09 kept fourteen candidates, revised eighteen and killed all four editions. Round 10 must remove editions, lead with the public product name, use filled actions on product-led cards, enlarge requested Wings and repair FN01 spacing.
Round 10 received 32 keeps and closed Phase A. Phase B may add functional behavior but may not restart visual exploration or restore killed paths.

stopConditions: Do not reuse rejected round concepts as unexplained decoration.
Do not reopen the approved Phase A grammar without a new human gate.
Do not animate more than one Living Core or use a finish other than Deep Mineral.
Do not hardcode product names, counts or assignments into components.
Do not change pricing authority, live Stripe code, homepage, Figma or consumers.

omitByDefault: raw early-round receipts unless exact evidence is needed

humanNotes: Olli rejected round 03: the editorial portrait, disc pedestal and sphere feature felt vibe-coded; the suite monogram was liked; pills must use the disc language; rarity variants matter; animated expression matters. The rebuild brief pointed at play-orb, expression atlas 02, product-family-commerce 01 and the taste research: premium, clear, intelligent, product-led, well paced, precise; the product is the visual protagonist; expression must communicate energy, intelligence or humanity; no corporate gradient atmosphere; alternate editorial calm with operational proof; design for future products beyond the current five.

Round 07 is the strongest round so far. Preserve the full-field footer, portrait object and bundle-offer champion; kill split identity, proof sequence, type led and paper sleeve; remove internal codes and numbers; refine mark placement, proportions, buttons, editions, bundles and direct-Wings website sections through controlled variants.

Round 08 produced 20 keeps, 16 kills, 13 revisions and one unreviewed landing plate. Remove every killed path. Centre or enlarge Wings where requested, prefer the filled landing action, make the dark full-field card one continuous charcoal chassis, flatten material joins, clean bundle strokes and fan spacing, add one light single card from ST02, and centre the requested hero and offer identity.

Round 09 produced 14 keeps, 18 revisions and four killed editions. Remove the edition family. On product-led cards put the canonical public product name first, the canonical extended system name second and supporting copy third. Use filled actions consistently on landing plates, product cards and product heroes. Enlarge requested Wings and rebuild FN01 with legible spacing and positioning.

Round 10 produced 32 keeps. Olli described the result as really, really good, explicitly closed Phase A and asked that the rich ten-round preference trail become guidance for the rest of the design system. Phase B must inherit rather than reinterpret it.
